name: Vasilii Andreev
introduction: Civil & structural engineering, existing bridges, and data-informed decisions over their service life. Selected research, structural design, inspections and technical investigations.

research_areas.title: Bridge lifecycle management
research_areas.description: Condition-informed inspection, maintenance and rehabilitation planning for existing bridges.

research_areas.title: Digital twins for infrastructure
research_areas.description: Connecting engineering models, inspection information and evolving asset records throughout service life.

research_areas.title: Structural assessment
research_areas.description: Linking structural analysis and observed condition to practical decisions about continued service and interventions.

about: I hold a six-year honours Specialist degree in Civil and Structural Engineering (Bridge and Tunnel Construction, 360 ECTS, ISCED 7) from SPbGASU. My professional experience since 2022 includes structural design, inspection and assessment of existing civil and industrial structures. I investigate lifecycle management of bridge infrastructure and the integration of structural assessments with digital methods for practical maintenance decisions.

skills.items: SOFiSTiK, SCAD Office, LIRA-SAPR; introductory PLAXIS 2D
Visual and instrumental surveys, defect mapping, condition assessment and verification calculations

research_statement: Bridge infrastructure as a long-term engineering system: from structural assessment to informed decisions on maintenance and rehabilitation.
research_note: Research interests include lifecycle-management methodology, digital twins for civil infrastructure, structural condition assessment and risk-informed maintenance planning.
about_points: Bridge and tunnel engineering specialist with a six-year honours engineering degree
Professional structural design and assessment experience since 2022
Research interest: lifecycle management of bridges, digital twins and evidence-based maintenance
intro_scope: Structural design of buildings and bridges

about_sections.label: ENGINEERING PRACTICE · 2022–PRESENT
about_sections.title: Structural design, inspection and assessment
about_sections.body: Structural Design Engineer, Category I, at URBAN LLC in Saint Petersburg. I joined as a technician in 2022, advanced to Category III in 2024 and to Category I in 2026.
points: Design and verification of steel and reinforced-concrete structures for industrial and civil buildings
Visual and instrumental inspections, dimensional and geodetic surveys, defect mapping and non-destructive assessment
Field-data analysis, verification calculations and repair or strengthening solutions for existing structures
Design documentation in AutoCAD, Revit and Tekla Structures; coordination with architectural and building-services disciplines

about_sections.label: ACADEMIC RESEARCH · 2023–PRESENT
about_sections.title: Bridge lifecycle management and digital engineering
about_sections.body: I hold a six-year Specialist degree with honours in Bridge and Tunnel Construction (SPbGASU, GPA 4.93/5.00) and have pursued research at SPbGASU and independently since 2023. I began postgraduate studies in Construction Technology and Management in 2026.
points: Developed a methodology for evaluating the effectiveness and performance of lifecycle-management systems for construction assets
Extended the assessment methodology to bridge infrastructure and applied it to the Alarchin Bridge case study
Investigated the economic implications of digital twins and their potential use in inspection- and condition-informed maintenance planning
Published research on lifecycle-management methods, digital twins in construction and bridge-specific applications
